 Magnitude 5.4 earthquake shakes Tokyo and nearby prefectures; no tsunami alert issued
 Wednesday, 28 October 2026, 17:57 
 Photo source: The Japan Times 
 Authorities set up an information office after the quake, while police had received no reports of damage or injuries by 12:20 a.m. 
 Tokyo and surrounding prefectures were shaken early Thursday by a magnitude 5.4 earthquake in northeastern Chiba Prefecture.
 This is reported by The Japan Times .
 The quake struck at 12:07 a.m. at a depth of 50 kilometers in Yokoshibahikari, according to the Japan Meteorological Agency. It registered lower 5 on Japan’s seven-point shindo seismic scale. No tsunami alert was issued.
 The government established an information liaison office at the Prime Minister’s Office at 12:11 a.m. to gather information and assess damage, NHK reported.
 Chiba Prefectural Police had received no reports of damage or injuries caused by the quake as of 12:20 a.m. and were continuing to monitor the situation, NHK reported.
